text_block_list.text:
One day, while looking for training books
in the library……

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That book!
I was curious about it too!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Heheh... I am always thinking about it, you see!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
To run a race where no one slips away,
what is the key factor...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
How about YOU!?
What is the most important thing to YOU!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Speed...! I see! Run fast, cut ahead! Aaaand――

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yesss! I will try it right away!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you!
With a burst of speed, you're not getting away~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I see! Pin everyone down with pure power!
Aaand――

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yesss! I will try it right away!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you!
Get ready for a powerful hold~!
